scripts.build: npm run check:locales && tsc -b && vite build && npm run check:no-localhost
scripts.check:no-localhost:
node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');let h='';try{h=execSync('grep -rlE "localhost:[0-9]+" dist',{stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).toString().trim()}catch{};if(h){console.error('
  BUILD REJECTED: a localhost API URL was baked into the bundle.
  Almost certainly VITE_API_URL in .env.local — Vite loads that in production too.
  Use .env.development.local instead.
  Files: '+h.replace(/
/g,', ')+'
');process.exit(1)}"
